artifacts.summary: 3-phase config-only plan: gate-20 budget headroom re-baseline, gates 3/4/10 timeout_s 60->180, redeploy plus full-sweep verification.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's agent-system, a plan whose phase touches scripts/gate-registry.data or scripts/tests/known-failures.txt must verify against the MECHANICALLY SELECTED suite set, not a hand-picked suite: suite-selection-lib.sh's suite_selection_select returns 10 suites for those paths (test-gate-registry-resolution.sh, test-gate-cache-lib.sh, test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh, test-deploy-baseline-lib.sh, test-gate8-expected-new-distinction.sh, test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh, test-run-all-failure-reporting.sh, test-run-all-selection.sh, test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh, test-verify-deploy-gate-selection-crash-net.sh). validate-artifact.sh catches an under-verifying Tier Justification against this selection at plan-acceptance time, so run it before returning any plan. Pair the --only list with --fail-on-new, since test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh already carries a declared load-sensitive known-failures row and costs ~543s.
